newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Plane crashes in Sao Paulo, at least 20 dead.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes in Sao Paulo, at least 20 dead.

text.p: A commercial airliner carrying about 94 people crashed into a densely populated residential area shortly after take off on Thursday, killing at least 20 people, authorities and news reports said.
Television news footage showed burning wreckage of the Fokker-100, belonging to Brazilian regional airline TAM, strewn amid a block of homes in southwest Sao Paulo.
Firemen were busily trying to rescue victims from the wreckage and at least 15 bodies were lined up near the site of the crash. There were no immediate reports of surviviors from the plane.
Airport officials said 90 people were on board the flight but news reports said the plane was carrying 89 people and five crew members.
It was not immediately clear whether the plane was headed for Rio de Janeiro or the capital of Brasilia.
News reports said at least five homes were destroyed in the crash.
